title: GRADE is a method for grading the certainty of evidence and the strength of recommendations
summary: GRADE is a method for grading the certainty of evidence and the strength of recommendations.
body: The GRADE Working Group describes its approach as grading the quality, or certainty, of evidence and the strength of recommendations, from evidence to recommendations. The source says: "The working group has developed a common, sensible and transparent approach to grading quality (or certainty) of evidence and strength of recommendations." Certainty of evidence and strength of a recommendation are separated by the group's own description. A strong recommendation is not, on that description, the same claim as high-certainty evidence.
